title: Integrate plantool through structured CLI operations
description: Start with read-only goal, ticket, decision and context lookups using plantool JSON output and explicit project cwd. Add scoped create/update actions only under the autonomy policy. Use subprocess argument arrays, validate outputs, preserve person-owned decisions and avoid duplicate tickets. Never edit .plan records directly or copy the whole runtime event log into tickets.
why: The assistant should refine and follow the same plan the user sees in plantool serve.

acceptance.text: Lookup returns the correct project and ticket references
Read-only scope cannot mutate a plan
Authorized updates appear in the planning web UI
Person-owned choices remain pending until the person chooses

outcome.summary: Integrated Plantool lookup, task create/update, and comment tools into the assistant. Verified argument-array JSON calls use the explicit project root, lookups expose only read operations, writes require an explicit latest-user request, exact-title duplicates are reused, and person-owned decisions/options are protected. Added five integration tests; project checks and Plantool validation pass. Commit ce1ece7.
